pages.text: $(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)Small decorative cable-mounted spikes that you can use to prevent cables from connecting, create ladders with cables, or make the cable appear connected to the walls around it. Also used to craft $(l:items_blocks_machines/facades)Cable Facade$(/l).$(br2)Cable anchors prevent connections from forming on
the side they're mounted on.$(br2)You can climb them like a ladder.
